'''Rogers''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Private/Legends|Private]] of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was assigned to an [[Reclamation Service Hoth expedition|excavation]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he served under [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Talos Drellik]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Private Rogers appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Hoth.
